langHint: All explanations and settings will use this language. You can change it later.
deviceHint: We checked your computer to suggest what suits it best.
gpuNone: No NVIDIA card, so it runs on the processor and is slower
recommendCloud: We recommend cloud mode with a free Gemini key: it listens and translates most accurately.
localCapable: Your computer is also strong enough for local mode, if you want to work offline.
localNot: Local mode needs a graphics card with 8 GB or more, so cloud mode suits this computer better.
engineCloudHint: Free, the most accurate listening and translation, needs internet.
engineLocalHint: No key and no internet, lower quality, needs a strong graphics card.
engineAdvancedHint: Pick one provider for listening and one for translating.
keyNone: Your choice does not need any key.
keyRejected: The provider refused this key. Check that you copied all of it.
keyShape: That does not look like a key. Check that you copied all of it.
keysMissing: Save the required keys before continuing.
toolsHint: The essentials download now, the rest only when you need them.
tool_timing_hint: Makes subtitles appear exactly when people speak.
tool_accuracy_hint: A second opinion on timing, and listening without internet.
tool_dubbing_hint: Clones each person's voice and keeps the music.
tool_local_translation_hint: A translation model on this computer. Needs the Ollama app.
requiredMissing: Download the essential tools before continuing.
extHint: Translate any video while browsing, with a right-click or the extension button.
extStep1: Open the extensions page in Chrome (chrome://extensions) and turn on Developer mode.
extStep2: Press Load unpacked and choose this folder:
extStep3: Open the extension and press Connect automatically. A request will appear here for you to allow.
pairAsk: A browser extension wants to connect to tarjim
doneHint: Start with your first video: drop a file or paste a link.
dropHint: Any video or audio from your computer, in any language.
badFile: That file is not a video or audio file.
voiceClone: Each speaker's own voice (on this computer)
empty: Nothing translated yet. Drop a file above or paste a link.
err_quota: The free quota is used up for today. It comes back tomorrow, or use local mode.
err_key: The key is missing or was refused. Check it in Settings.
err_download: Could not download the video from that link. Check that the link works.
err_tools: ffmpeg is not installed on this computer.
err_dub: No dubbing voice for this language yet. Try subtitles instead.
engineSubscriptionHint: Translate with the plan you already pay for, through its own app on this computer. No keys.
subscriptionNone: Claude Code or Codex was not found on this computer. Install one, sign in with your plan, then come back.
connectHint: Pick what suits you: a key from any provider, your monthly subscription, or a model running on this computer.
modelLabel: Model (pick from the list or type any name)
subscriptionInstall: This subscription's app is not installed. Install it with this command, sign in with your account, then press Check again.
subscriptionReady: The app is installed. Press Sign in and your browser opens so you can sign in to your account.
localNone: No AI program is running on your device yet.
listenLocal: a local model on this computer (Qwen)
connectNotReady: That choice is not ready: add the key, install the app, or start the local model.
chatHint: Add tarjim to the chat app you use, then just say "translate this link".
chat_codex_hint: ChatGPT in the terminal and the Codex app.
chatRestart: Restart the Claude app to see tarjim.
chatFailed: Could not add it. Make sure the app is installed.
keySet: Key saved (type a new one to replace it)
consentCheck: I have read and accept the {name} (non-commercial use only)
ffmpegLater: missing, we install it in the Tools step
gpuFix: To let tarjim use your graphics card (much faster local listening), run this once, then restart tarjim.
tool_ffmpeg_hint: Reads the video and burns the subtitles. On Windows we install it for you; on macOS or Linux run brew install ffmpeg or sudo apt install ffmpeg.
localAfterFix: Your card is strong enough for local mode once you run the command below.
signInWaiting: Your browser opened. Sign in there; this page updates by itself.
signInCodeLabel: If the sign-in page shows you a code, paste it here
signInConsole: A window opened for this program. Sign in there, then come back here.
signInFailed: Sign-in could not start. Make sure the app is installed, then try again.
localInstalled: {name} is installed on your device but not running.
localStarting: Starting, this takes a few seconds.
localStartFailed: It did not start. Open the program yourself, then press Search my device.
localNoStart: Open {name}, turn on its local server, then press Search my device.
localSearchHint: With your permission, tarjim looks through your program folders for Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, llama.cpp and KoboldCpp. Nothing leaves your device.
localSearching: Searching your device, this can take up to 20 seconds.
localSearchNone: Nothing found. If the program is somewhere else, paste the path of its file here.
localPathBad: That is not a file tarjim knows. Use ollama.exe, lms.exe, Jan.exe, llama-server.exe or koboldcpp.exe.
listenHint: Gemini hears best in most languages. The local model keeps the audio on your device.
